summary: Iter38r-fix9z7 + fix9z8 (WhatsApp reminders + live admin WS dashboard + self-service advertiser portal) FULLY VALIDATED. Backend pytest on the preview URL: 41/41 PASS across test_iter38r_fix9z7_wa_live.py (6/6), test_iter38r_fix9z8_self_service.py (8/8 — Stripe-dependent test PASSED, meaning a Stripe key IS configured in this env), test_iter38r_fix9z6_ab_reminder.py (8/8), test_iter38r_fix9z5_sizing_renewal_chart.py (9/9), test_iter38r_fix9w_ad_banners.py (10/10). Validated: (1) process_expiration_reminders accepts send_email_fn + send_whatsapp_fn DI stubs and routes correctly when both/email-only/wa-only toggles are active, (2) WA-only banner with no phone is silently skipped (no channels delivered), (3) WS /api/ws/ad-banners-live emits snapshot then broadcasts impression+click events with per-variant counters, (4) WS rejects invalid JWT and non-admin roles (close 4401), (5) PUT /api/public/ads-report/{slug}/media updates ONLY whitelisted media fields (image_url, media_kind, target_url, variant_b_*) — admin-only fields like active/budget_amount/placement preserved; audit row written to ad_self_service_updates collection; bad token → 403; empty payload → 400, (6) POST /checkout: bad token → 403, amount_xof<=0 → 422, with valid Stripe config returns {url, session_id} and inserts ad_renewals row with payment_status='initiated' + renewal_applied=False, (7) GET /payment-status/{session_id} returns 404 for unknown sessions. FRONTEND Playwright on the preview URL (after admin auth injection + frontend restart to clear stale bundle): (a) /admin/ad-banners — new 'Bannières actives en temps réel' panel [data-testid=ad-banners-live-panel] renders at top, WebSocket connects and [data-testid=ad-live-status] shows green 'Connecté' badge, (b) 'Nouvelle bannière' form — BannerContactReminderBlock shows BOTH new checkboxes [data-testid=ad-reminder-enable] AND [data-testid=ad-reminder-wa-enable] (verified present), (c) Created banner via API → opened public report at /ads/portal-ui-test?token=... — both new sections render: [data-testid=ads-report-pay-cta] 'Payer en ligne · renouvellement instantané' opens form with montant/durée/email + 'Payer 50 000 XOF' button (Stripe), [data-testid=ads-report-media-cta] 'Mettre à jour mon visuel' opens uploader + URL de destination input + 'Enregistrer' button. NOTE: the new fix9z8 frontend components were NOT visible at first load due to stale webpack hot-reload bundle — a `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` fixed it. Not a code issue, just a hot-reload artifact of the preview env.
critical_code_review_comments: Good: process_expiration_reminders now accepts send_whatsapp_fn alongside send_email_fn — both DI-injected at scheduler boot via setup_ad_banners_routes(wa_send_text=_wa_send_text). Trivially unit-testable.
Good: WA-only banner with reminder_wa_enabled=True but advertiser_phone='' is gracefully skipped (no channels list returned), preventing crash on missing recipient.
Good: WS /api/ws/ad-banners-live validates token AND role=admin before accepting connection (close code 4401 on failure). No leaky data path.

Good: PUT /media uses a Pydantic MediaUpdatePayload that whitelists only image_url/media_kind/target_url/variant_b_*; extra fields (active, budget_amount, placement) are silently dropped by FastAPI before reaching DB. Defence-in-depth verified.
Good: Audit collection ad_self_service_updates captures {banner_id, fields, source_ip, updated_at} per call — useful for forensic review if an advertiser claims they didn't change anything.

Good: Checkout creates ad_renewals row with renewal_applied=False FIRST then redirects to Stripe; payment-status polling flips the flag atomically (CAS) only when Stripe confirms 'paid' — prevents double-application on retries.

Minor (not blocking): When the webpack dev server has been running for a while, hot-reload sometimes doesn't propagate to module-level component additions (OnlineRenewalCheckout, SelfServiceMediaUpdate). First load post-deploy may need a frontend restart. Production build won't have this issue.

WebSocket wss://…/api/ws/ad-banners-live?token=<adminJWT>; AdLiveHub broadcasts {event:'impression'|'click', banner_id, variant, total_*} on every POST /impression or /click. Public self-service endpoints: PUT /api/public/ads-report/{slug}/media?token=... (whitelisted fields only, 400 on empty body, 403 on bad token), POST /api/public/ads-report/{slug}/checkout?token=... (returns {url, session_id} or 500 'Stripe non configuré'), GET /api/public/ads-report/{slug}/payment-status/{session_id}?token=... (renewal_applied flips atomically on 'paid'). rca of the issue: No issues found. Initial frontend test showed missing fix9z8 components — root cause was stale webpack hot-reload bundle in the long-running dev server; after `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` the components rendered correctly. This is a dev-env artifact, not a code bug; production build (yarn build) embeds all modules at compile time and is unaffected.
